author: benjaminion
content: Hi All - I've posted [the agenda](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2305) for tomorrow's ACDC call. FYI, I do not plan to make any decision around FOCIL tomorrow, but we should use the time to explore options and express preferences. Participation from EL devs is also welcome. Decision making will be in two weeks, along with revisiting the other items in the Heze scope, with a goal of getting everything wrapped up in that call. For those unable to attend tomorrow (happy Thanksgiving!), I'll start a thread here for async input, so feel free to post links to blogs etc. Nevertheless, what is said on the call remains the most transparent and governance relevant, so please bear that in mind.
